criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Add rest_framework to INSTALLED_APPS in your project and record the installed version. Keep dependency versions in requirements.txt. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create ProductSerializer with explicit id, name, price and stock fields. Serialize Pen and show a JSON-compatible dictionary; serialize a list using many=True. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Instantiate with data= for valid Pen input and invalid negative stock. Call is_valid and record validated_data or field errors; invalid input must not save. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Make id read-only. Supply an arbitrary id in input and demonstrate the client cannot choose an existing row’s primary key on creation. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Strip and validate name with validate_name. Show blank input rejected and padded valid input normalized. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Call save after successful validation to create then update a Product. Record row count and values; explain instance= versus data=. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use partial=True to change stock alone. Show name remains unchanged. Compare the same incomplete input under full validation and record which fields are required. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
